column2: Graph: L4 consequence class reached by the threat. 5 displacement, 4 deception, 3 regional denial or flagged degradation, 2 local denial, 1 disclosure only. Enablers have no Damage.

Atlas: highest evidence among bound entries (P 1, E0 2, E1 3, E2 4, E3 5), minus one when the evidence is from an analogue system only (floor 1). Non-malicious failures (#76 to #78) are path evidence and do not raise the level.
Threat model: tier of the adversary class. 5 T1 public tools, 4 T1 custom software, 3 T2, 2 T3, 1 T3 with insider or two classes.
Graph: extent of the root event. 5 whole constellation, 4 several footprints, 3 one footprint, 2 several aircraft, 1 one aircraft.
Graph: first layer at which a detection predicate is true. 1 at L1, 2 at L2, 3 at L3, 4 only at L4, 5 no check detects it. 5 is the riskier end (hard to discover). Scored in a strong and a weak pass.
S = D + R + E + A + Di, 5 to 25. Low 5-9, Medium 10-14, High 15-19, Critical 20-25. Chains: MIN over AND steps for R, E, A, Di; OR takes the higher total; Damage from the root.
